correctness.rationale: For \(n\ge6\) and \(0<\varepsilon<n^{-2}\), the curvature numerator is bounded below by \((1-n\varepsilon)(1-n^2\varepsilon)>0\). Tangent length \(R\tan\theta\) and curvature radius \((1+sn\varepsilon)^2/(1+sn^2\varepsilon)\) give the exact area-preserving Jacobian after frame rotation. Monotonicity of the resulting trace yields the primitive multipliers and all scalar resonance parameters. Distinct co-rotating elliptic eigenvalues imply full return derivative \((-1)^jI\) at each listed resonance. Explicit boundary expansions give the sharp exponents; finite-difference comparisons from the packaged checker corroborate critical formulas but are not used as proof.
